Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting mobile home park sewer-related charges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mobile home park sewerrelated charges; andamending RCW 35.67.370.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.67.370 and 2003 c 297 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Cities, towns, or counties may not require existing mobile homeparks to replace existing, functional septic systems with a sewersystem within the community unless the local board of health determinesthat the septic system is failing. (2) Cities, towns, and counties are prohibited from requiringexisting mobile home parks to pay any charges related to sewer, toinclude, but not exclusively, a sewer service availability charge,standby charge, consumption charge, or any other similar types ofcharges associated with available but unused sewer service, includingany interest or penalties for nonpayment or enforcement charges, untilthe mobile home park connects to the sewer service. When a mobile homepark connects to a sewer, cities, towns, and counties may only chargemobile home parks prospectively from the date of connection for their p. 1 HB 2717sewer service. Chapter 297, Laws of 2003 is remedial in nature andapplies retroactively to 1993.
